==========================
Cast words as plain function names
==========================

<?php
function int($x) { return $x; }
echo int(1);

---

(program
  (php_tag)
  (function_definition
    (name)
    (formal_parameters
      (simple_parameter
        (variable_name
          (name))))
    (compound_statement
      (return_statement
        (variable_name
          (name)))))
  (echo_statement
    (function_call_expression
      (name)
      (arguments
        (argument
          (integer))))))

==========================
Cast words as constant subscripts
==========================

<?php
const OBJECT = [1];
echo OBJECT[0];

---

(program
  (php_tag)
  (const_declaration
    (const_element
      (name)
      (array_creation_expression
        (array_element_initializer
          (integer)))))
  (echo_statement
    (subscript_expression
      (name)
      (integer))))
